content.summary: An adult perfumer connects dew, botanicals and one spray to an AFTERLIGHT hero bottle. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One adult model and one product design persist. + Material inserts share one controlled highlight family. + Only one spray action occurs. + Typography is original and exact. + The final frame reconnects product, person and motif.
quick_start.recommended_input: A fingertip touches one dew-covered copper leaf whose droplet reflects an original perfume bottle. Alternate three macro inserts: vanilla pod, ivory blossom and wet citrus peel, preserving the amber highlight. Let pale petals pass once, then lock the original bottle on stone with the exact mark AFTERLIGHT beside the perfumer.
